name: concurrent-turns-in-one-session-all-survive
description: SPEC.md 4.11 under contention: prompts in one session at once MUST all land in its history. A save that reads, appends and writes the whole record lets the last writer erase another prompt's completed turn - the 2026-09-04 principal review (F-06) found exactly that read, append, upsert sequence. Every write carries the version it was based on, the store refuses a stale one, and the loop re-reads and tries again, so four concurrent prompts leave four turns.
